newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac congratulates Greece's Simitis on victory.
newsitem.headline: Chirac congratulates Greece's Simitis on victory.

text.p: France's conservative President Jacques Chirac on Wednesday congratulated Greece's socialist Prime Minister Costas Simitis on his victory in a weekend general election.
"Following your party's brilliant electoral victory, it is a pleasure for me to present my warm congratulations and my best wishes for your success," Chirac wrote in a message released by his office.
Chirac said he hoped to reinforce cooperation between the two countries and was looking forward to meeting Simitis at a special European Union summit in Dublin next month.

Simitis, 60, was sworn in for a four-year term on Wednesday after beating Greek opposition leader Miltiades Evert. In January he succeeded his mentor, ailing socialist party founder and three-term prime minister Andreas Papandreou, who died in June.
